PUT /api/v1/kinds/{kind_id}/keeping.summary: Set or take away the keeping time of a kind (manage in its vault; the operator for the server's)

PUT /api/v1/logs/level.summary: Change the level, effective at once

PUT /api/v1/me/email.summary: Give a new mail address; with a mail server it counts once its link is opened

PUT /api/v1/me/language.summary: The language of the own account; empty follows the browser

PUT /api/v1/me/preferences.summary: The own profile choices; only the values sent change

PUT /api/v1/me/profile.summary: The own display name, username and address

PUT /api/v1/me/reminders.summary: Change how the own account is reminded; only the values sent change

PUT /api/v1/oidc/admin/providers/order.summary: Put the providers in this order (the drag handle)

PUT /api/v1/oidc/admin/providers/{provid.summary: Save a provider; another issuer drops its links

PUT /api/v1/push/devices/{device_id}.summary: Give an own device another name

PUT /api/v1/senders/{sender_id}/memo.summary: Change the vault's note on a sender (edit in its vault; members of the vault see it)

PUT /api/v1/settings/ai.summary: Choose the AI service of the server; only the fields sent change

PUT /api/v1/settings/intake.summary: Change the intake folder or the mailbox

PUT /api/v1/settings/ocr.summary: Change the settings of the text recognition (from the next file)

PUT /api/v1/settings/paperless.summary: Change the address, token or switch

PUT /api/v1/settings/push.summary: Who the push services may contact, and push services beyond the known ones

PUT /api/v1/settings/shortcut.summary: Set or take away the iCloud link of the iPhone shortcut (operator)

PUT /api/v1/uploads/{upload_id}.summary: Send the next piece (raw bytes) at the offset where the last one ended

PUT /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/members.summary: Set who is in the vault with which right, all at once (managers); a refusal changes nothing

PUT /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/members/{u.summary: Give a person a right in the vault, or change it (managers)
